question: Considering everything Subaru accomplished after causing various problems at the beginning of the Royal Selection in Arc 3—such as contributing to the defeat of the White Whale, the elimination of the Sin Archbishop of Sloth and the Sin Archbishop of Greed, and reaching the Pleiades Watchtower—how do the members of the Wise Council view him? Is Subaru's name frequently brought up during meetings of the Wise Council?
answer:
When all the members of the Wise Council gather together, I imagine they're all holding their heads in their hands, thinking, “Give me a break!”

They probably have conversations like:

“It's great that the White Whale and the Sin Archbishop of Sloth are gone, but...”

“Why does it have to be Emilia's camp...? It could have been any of the other four... If it had been one of the other four, we could rejoice wholeheartedly...”

It's basically, “Seriously, what's going on?” because everything keeps happening one thing after another.

The Wise Council consists of around seven elderly wise men, and I think their opinions are split roughly 3:3:1.

Three belong to the “It's fine because Emilia is doing her best” camp.

Three belong to the “No matter how hard she tries, she's no good” camp.

And one is simply, “Let's just go along with the flow.”

Well, they aren't exactly welcoming her with open arms.

She's basically seen as a huge headache.
